table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode,
			headerinvno,
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.custcode,
			custrefno,
			custrefno2,
			custrefno3,
			custrefno4,
			originaldate,
			date,
			billingdate,
			duedate,
			saletypecode,
			deliveredby,
			invtotal,
			unreceivedbalance,
			invoicesize,
			recurringinvoice,
			recurringperiod,
			printwaranty,
			printbatch,
			patientcode,
		   relationcode,
			diseasecode,
			wardcode,
			doctcode,
			paid

  FROM 	saleledger, accounts

  WHERE 
			:ai_period = 1 AND
			saleledger.custcode = CASE :ai_all WHEN 0 THEN :al_custcode ELSE saleledger.custcode END AND
			saleledger.originaldate BETWEEN :ad_sdate AND :ad_edate AND
			saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode
UNION
  SELECT saleinvcode,
			headerinvno,
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.custcode,
			custrefno,
			custrefno2,
			custrefno3,
			custrefno4,
			originaldate,
			date,
			billingdate,
			duedate,
			saletypecode,
			deliveredby,
			invtotal,
			unreceivedbalance,
			invoicesize,
			recurringinvoice,
			recurringperiod,
			printwaranty,
			printbatch,
			patientcode,
		   relationcode,
			diseasecode,
			wardcode,
			doctcode,
			paid

  FROM 	saleledger, accounts

  WHERE 
			:ai_period = 2 AND
			saleledger.custcode = CASE :ai_all WHEN 0 THEN :al_custcode ELSE saleledger.custcode END AND
			saleledger.saleinvcode BETWEEN :ai_sinvcode AND :ai_linvcode AND
			saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode
